create_story_sequence: create a Story object that sequences multiple pycolab games as a programmable storyline
build_story_with_croppers: build a Story with observation croppers to ensure identically-shaped observations across all games
run_story_episode: run a Story episode by calling its_showtime then play with actions until game_over
test_story_compatibility: test that multiple pycolab games are compatible for use in a Story by checking character usage and observation shapes
review_story_things: review the Story.things attribute to inspect current game entities and dummy placeholders
